events.name: Kansas City Royals at Detroit Tigers

headlines.description: — Nick Loftin hit a tie-breaking home run in the ninth inning as the Kansas City Royals rallied for a 3-2 victory over the Detroit Tigers on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nick Loftin and Salvador Perez hit late-inning home runs as Royals rally to beat Tigers 3-2

headlines.description: — CJ Abrams hit a solo home run and drove in three for the Washington Nationals in a 5-3 win over the Arizona Diamondbacks on Saturday afternoon.
headlines.shortLinkText: CJ Abrams homers, drives in three runs as the Nationals beat the Diamondbacks 5-3

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Rafael Devers and Jung Hoo Lee hit three-run homers, Robbie Ray pitched six shutout innings and the San Francisco Giants beat the Los Angeles Angels 9-2 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Devers, Lee hit 3-run homers, Ray pitches 6 shutout innings as Giants beat Angels 9-2

events.name: San Diego Padres at Miami Marlins

headlines.description: — Ty France drove in three runs, JP Sears gave up one hit and struck out three over 3 1/3 innings, and the San Diego Padres extended the Miami Marlins' losing streak to 11 with a 7-2 win on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ty France drives in 3 as the Padres beat the Marlins 7-2, extend Miami skid to 11

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Dylan Cease took a no-hitter into the sixth inning and finished with a one-hit complete game, George Springer hit a three-run homer to highlight a five-run third and the Toronto Blue Jays cooled off the Boston Red Sox 6-0 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dylan Cease dominates the Red Sox, throws a one-hitter in the Blue Jays' 6-0 victory

events.name: New York Yankees at Philadelphia Phillies

headlines.description: — Austin Wells and Jasson Domínguez homered, Ryan Weathers pitched into the sixth inning, and the New York Yankees beat the Philadelphia Phillies 3-1 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wells and Domínguez homer to lead New York Yankees past Philadelphia Phillies 3-1

events.name: Cleveland Guardians at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Nick Martinez threw six sharp innings, Yandy Díaz became the fourth player in Tampa Bay history to reach 1,000 hits and the Rays shut out the slumping Cleveland Guardians 3-0 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nick Martinez and 3 relievers pitch AL-best Rays to 3-0 win over slumping Guardians

headlines.description: — Pete Crow-Armstrong was 4 for 5 with a home run and three RBI to lead the Chicago Cubs to an 11-0 rout of the Pittsburgh Pirates on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Crow-Armstrong powers the Cubs to an 11-0 rout of the Pirates

headlines.description: — Dylan Beavers singled home a run in the bottom of the ninth inning to give the Baltimore Orioles a 3-2 win over the Atlanta Braves on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Beavers' 9th-inning hit gives the Orioles a 3-2 victory over the Braves

headlines.description: — Alan Roden hit a two-run single to snap Minnesota's scoreless streak at 14 2/3 innings and the Twins beat the Athletics 2-0 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Roden's 2-RBI single, and Rojas' strong start on short notice help Twins top Athletics 2-0

headlines.description: — Rookies Cooper Pratt and Luis Lara drove in three runs apiece and Robert Gasser worked six solid innings as the Milwaukee Brewers beat the Colorado Rockies 8-5 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookies Pratt, Lara drive in 3 runs apiece, Gasser works 6 innings as Brewers beat Rockies 8-5

events.name: Houston Astros at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Hunter Brown pitched seven shutout innings of two-hit ball and Isaac Paredes had three RBI as the Houston Astros beat the Chicago White Sox 4-1 on Saturday night for their fifth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hunter Brown pitches Astros past White Sox 4-1 for 5th straight win

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Kyle Tucker homered for the second consecutive game, Yoshinobu Yamamoto allowed one run in six gritty innings and the Los Angeles Dodgers capitalized on two defensive mistakes by the New York Mets in a 4-3 victory Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tucker homers again and Yamamoto allows 1 run in 6 innings as Dodgers beat sloppy Mets 4-3

events.name: Cincinnati Reds at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Andre Pallante matched his season high with eight strikeouts in seven strong innings, and the St. Louis Cardinals scored six runs in the bottom of the sixth in a 7-0 win over the Cincinnati Reds on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pallante matches season high with 8 Ks, to lead Cardinals to a 7-0 win over the Reds

headlines.description: — Nathan Eovaldi gave up three hits and struck out eight in seven innings while Wyatt Langford and Joc Pederson had three hits each for the Texas Rangers in a 7-1 win over the Seattle Mariners on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nathan Eovaldi strikes out 8 as the Rangers beat the Mariners 7-1
